_comment: Frozen fixture copy of the shipped WP-20 L3 unlock catalog (critic F1). It exists so a boot on the frozen fixture never reads the SHIPPED unlocks.json: a change to shipped balance data must never move a fixture test's expectations. rune.inferno is deliberately absent - the only shipped row whose target rune the fixture carries, and a kind=rune row would remove that rune from the fixture's rune-offer pool. The remaining rows touch neither a fixture rune (rune.chain is not a fixture rune) nor any fixture unit pool (skill.hook/bash/mark/pin/storm are not fixture skills; skill.shackle is a fixture skill but in no fixture pool), so the fixture offer/roster behaviour stays exactly what it was before WP-21.
